name: @bojackduy/opencode-fleet
description: Lightweight orchestrator → workers for OpenCode (file spool + prompt_async, takeover-friendly; v1+v2 compatible).
author: bojackduy

scripts.prepack: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:minor: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:major: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
